checks.description: Controlled press requests activity without mutating selected overview, while active entry moves to requested Tab.

tests.name: TabList reports controlled selection requests without mutating the selected value

checks.description: Uncontrolled activation updates selected and roving entry and preserves child press exactly once.

tests.name: TabList updates uncontrolled selection and preserves the Tab press handler

checks.description: default seeds once, controlled rerender wins without user notification, each requested value reports including automatic/manual/native Select; recovery does not mutate controlled value.
Stable caller order uses explicit value else controls, warns duplicate values, defaults first enabled even if leading disabled, updates inventory on insert/remove/reorder.
Required children, two orientations, controlled/default value callbacks, policy flags and ordinary structural View ref compile without panel/overflow APIs.
Children retain caller order/visual slots/styles, context owns group selection/disabled/position/roving handlers without cloning their visuals or redirecting structural ref.

Exactly one enabled selected or fallback-first Tab tabbable; active disable/remove recovers once, all disabled/group disabled has none, reenabling recovers, controlled selection is not silently rewritten.
Target registrations are stable/ref-backed, eligibility/selection commit before request; actual focus events confirm focused value, replaced/removed/superseded targets cancel stale work.
Synthetic horizontal ArrowRight skips disabled, updates automatic selection/entry, prevents default once and wraps.

tests.name: TabList moves automatic selection on the orientation axis and skips disabled Tabs

checks.description: Horizontal Left/Right and vertical Up/Down navigate enabled items; Home/End hit endpoints in both, circular true wraps/false stops, handled default prevented; inactive axis/unhandled/modifier keys forwarded untouched.
Physical navigation moves confirmed native focus with disabled skipping/wrap/Home/End; Tab/Shift+Tab enter/leave through one tab stop, modifier shortcuts reach parent without selection changes.
Manual navigation updates roving entry without selection until synthetic activation selects focused Tab.

tests.name: TabList keeps selection independent from roving focus in manual activation mode

checks.description: Automatic focus requests selection; manual Enter/Space/pointer requests once preserving child handlers; native Select uses same selection owner and original event without onPress synthesis.
Pointer updates active entry and selection; Windows/Win32 request committed target focus, macOS is not forced into Windows click-focus policy.
Default structural root exposes list name/disabled false/nonfocusable, first enabled selected/tabbable; all children including disabled contribute one-based position and total size.

tests.name: TabList defaults to the first enabled Tab and exposes the list semantics

checks.description: Native list/tab roles preserve independent child accessibility with selected/disabled/controls and caller group naming; no panel creation/hiding is implied.
Horizontal row/vertical column, alignItems/alignSelf flex-start and componentBase100 gap resolve with caller style last; no separate selection indicator or motion.
Review both orientations, caller styles, stable neighbor geometry and scaled-label spacing across native renderers.

limitations: Root is accessible in unit assertions although prose calls it structural; only native tree traversal can prove children are not collapsed.
Active tab stop and mocked focus invocation are not confirmed native focus; those claims remain native checks.
No native modified-chord, custom Select, screen-reader or geometry execution record is linked.
